name: figure53-qview
notes: Complete list: 3 actions (src/actions.js) and no feedbacks (src/index.js registers no feedback definitions; the module has no variables or presets).

Protocol: OSC over UDP via this.oscSend(host, port, address) with no arguments. Addresses sent: /goto/next, /goto/prev and /goto/page/<page> (src/index.js sendCommand, src/actions.js). Config fields: Target IP (regex Regex.IP, no default) and Target Port (textinput, regex Regex.PORT, default 60000).
The Page field is the shared Fields.Page of src/setup.js (line 2); it is a number option 1 to 9999 with default 1, no useVariables and no integer flag.
The module is on @companion-module/base ~1.10 (1.x), so option values are not expressions. Not tested against QView or Companion.
